Flow.description: Resolves the Campaign and GiftDesignation for a gift, then returns to the caller monolith. Steps: (1) Route on entry — Pledge Payment path seeds Campaign from the GC and starts at GC lookups; In-Kind / Earned Income branch to an optional Campaign picker; every other leaf goes to the required Campaign picker. (2) Load Campaign default designation (single) and Campaign GDD collection (multi). If >1 GDDs, flag Platform_Split. (3) On the Pledge Payment path, also load GC default designation and GC GDD collection; if >1, flag Platform_Split. (4) Run the resolver decision to pick a designation source in this order: Platform_Split → GC default → Campaign default → org-wide default. (5) On Confirm, either accept the resolver's pick or override — override routes commitment-creation leaves through a restriction-type picker first, then a designation datatable, both with a lookup escape hatch. (6) Return: out_resolvedPath (Accepted / MissingOrgDefault), out_selectedCampaignId, var_GD_ResolvedId, var_GD_ResolvedSource, and multi-GDD collections out_campaignGDDs / out_gcGDDs for caller-side platform fan-out. Any lookup fault jumps to Assign_DidError_True; caller inspects out_didError post-return.

assignments.description: Fault-path terminal for all 10 record lookups. Writes out_didError=true + a generic message; no connector so subflow returns to caller. Caller inspects out_didError post-return and routes to its own Error_CouldNotLoadData terminal Finish per plan §Error-screen-boundary (Shape B).

decisions.description: Earned Revenue count fork. Runs after Count_EarnedRevenue_GDs on the Earned Income / Event Registration branch. If exactly one Earned Revenue designation exists org-wide, iterate it once via Loop_EarnedRevenue_First and auto-select — the user does not see Confirm or Pick. If >1 exist, jump to Pick_Designation via Get_Filtered_Designations (which re-queries with var_RestrictionType='Earned Revenue' already set) so the user chooses from the filtered set. If 0 exist (org has not seeded an Earned Revenue GD yet), fall through to Get_Campaign_Default_Designations so the standard tier hierarchy still resolves a designation and the launcher does not dead-end.
